The Defective Detective — Album 5: Serah Asks

Back in Black

"Back in Black Back through wires"

[Verse 1] Back through the guarded entrance Black Zone humming like before Bobbie gives the usual greeting Coda barely clears the door

Straight to Nessa’s workshop Scanner first Analyzer next Then the keypad flashes red

Wrong code

Coda stares at it

Calls Nessa

[pause]

“What’s the code?”

Then Nessa says

“Coda sucks Pink Circuit rules 8-8-3-3-2-2-4.”

[silence]

Coda enters every number

Slowly

[Pre-Chorus] Deep-frequency scanner Portable residue analyzer Good soldering kit

Then three extra things Nobody asked for

Because somebody always will

[Chorus] Back in Black Back through wires Back where hidden circuits breathe Back in Black Take what’s needed Take three more just underneath Back in Black Home is coded Home remembers who came through Sometimes home means broken doorways Sometimes home means laughing at you

[Verse 2] Coda drops the gear beside her Takes a seat at her own screen Three old routes Two fresh passwords One protected Company stream

Viktor’s active

Of course he is

His presence flickers through the grid Coda slips between the barriers Just to see what he has hid

One wall closes She reroutes Another rises in its place Then one opening comes too easy

Coda pauses

Keeps the pace

[Pre-Chorus] She gets what she came to gather Nothing more Nothing grand One clean path through layered systems One old rhythm she understands

Then across the terminal A little smiling face Coda laughs beneath her breath

“Still playing games.”

[Chorus] Back in Black Back through wires Back where every signal bends Back in Black Old collisions Old opponents Maybe friends Back in Black Nothing spoken Nothing settled Nothing won Just one door that should have closed

And somehow didn’t

[Break] Coda shuts the system down Packs the gear Checks every latch

Then noise rises from the entrance

Raised voices Movement A crowd beginning to catch

She heads toward the gate

[Verse 3] Two Nekomimi stand outside Travel-worn beneath the light Silver pins still at their collars Old status polished bright

Bobbie blocks the narrow entrance Restricted zone Protected ground Not a place for random strangers Not a district you walk around

Coda slows behind the gathering Studies both from where she stands Silver badges tell one story

So she checks the registry bands

Orange

[pause]

She checks again

Orange

[Pre-Chorus] Silver on their collars Orange in the system Black beyond the gate Three different truths One little screen

And something doesn’t match

[Final Chorus] Back in Black Different doorway Different kind of thing to find Back in Black Old classifications Breaking somewhere down the line Back in Black Nothing stolen Nothing simple Nothing clean Sometimes all it takes is one wrong Color Where Silver should have been

Back in Black Watch the entrance Watch the stories rearrange Coda closes down her screen

And starts walking through the strange

[Outro] One Nekomimi turns toward her

Coda stops

Recognition almost there

The gate goes quiet
